2610.12927.title: Collaborative Learning and Reasoning over Model Slices
2610.12927.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel across diverse tasks, benefiting from knowledge priors, in-context reasoning, and test-time computation. Despite these strengths, single-model reasoning remains vulnerable to error propagation, as later steps depend on the model's earlier outputs, leaving reasoning blind spots difficult to independently reassess. To address this limitation, we develop \textit{collaborative learning}, encompassing the construction of heterogeneous collaborators and the learning of effective cross-model collaboration. Specifically, \textit{model slicing} replaces a large model with smaller, heterogeneous models under a comparable parameter budget, enabling prior reasoning to be reassessed across distinct model parameterizations. \textit{Pyramid supervision} combines protocol distillation with step-level supervision to refine reasoning and interaction decisions throughout collaboration. We evaluate our approach across four task categories: multi-hop question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and open-ended constrained generation. The trained heterogeneous models achieve comparable or better task performance than the original large model and established multi-agent baselines, including reinforcement-learning-based methods, while also achieving higher inference efficiency than the multi-agent baselines and exhibiting differentiated collaboration patterns across tasks. These findings show that learned collaboration turns model heterogeneity into complementary reasoning capabilities.
2610.12927.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在各種任務中表現出色，受益於知識先驗、上下文推理和測試時計算。儘管這些優勢，單一模型的推理仍然容易受到錯誤傳播的影響，因為後續步驟依賴於模型的早期輸出，這使得推理的盲點難以獨立重新評估。為了解決這一限制，我們開發了\textit{協作學習}，包括異質協作者的構建和有效跨模型協作的學習。具體而言，\textit{模型切片}在可比的參數預算下，用較小的異質模型替換大型模型，使先前的推理能夠在不同的模型參數化中重新評估。\textit{金字塔監督}將協議蒸餾與步驟級監督相結合，以在協作過程中細化推理和互動決策。我們在四個任務類別中評估我們的方法：多跳問題回答、數學推理、代碼生成和開放式受限生成。訓練後的異質模型在任務表現上達到了與原始大型模型和已建立的多代理基準相當或更好的效果，包括基於強化學習的方法，同時在推理效率上也優於多代理基準，並在不同任務中展現出差異化的協作模式。這些發現表明，學習的協作將模型的異質性轉化為互補的推理能力。
